_help: Hand-written setup notes shown at the top of a skill's 'How to use it' tab. Key: a skill id (owner/repo::path) or a whole repository (owner/repo). Edited by hand; the nightly build leaves this file alone.

notes.Graphify-Labs/graphify: Needs Python on your computer. The first time you run /graphify it installs its own helper program (graphifyy) automatically. Building a graph from documents, images or video uses noticeably more AI usage than code alone.
